people.name: Haggai
people.line: A prophet who encouraged the rebuilding of the temple.

people.name: Jehozadak
people.line: Father of Joshua the high priest during the exile.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: High priest during the rebuilding of the temple

people.name: Shealtiel
people.line: Grandfather of Zerubbabel, descendant of David

people.name: Zerubbabel
people.line: Leader of the first Jewish exiles from Babylon

translations.web: Then Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed Yahweh, their God’s voice, and the words of Haggai, the prophet, as Yahweh, their God, had sent him; and the people feared Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the words of the prophet Haggai, because the LORD their God had sent him. So the people feared the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the LORD.
translations.asv: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of Jehovah their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Jehovah their God had sent him; and the people did fear before Jehovah.
